name: Invoice by Ouroboros
description: Stores a freelancer's approved invoice: line items, quantities, approved rates, due date, and late terms. An AI assistant cannot add a line, change a rate, invent a discount, or move a due date unless that change is explicitly approved. Tools: list_invoices, begin_invoice, read_invoice, place_line, describe_line, quote_line_rate, set_line_quantity, set_invoice_due, write_late_terms, offer_discount, seal_invoice, suggest_invoice_change, accept_invoice_change. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/invoice. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/invoice. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
